Generated native-player test video

selected.wmv contains 12 seconds of original FFmpeg test patterns, a visible
BLADES NATIVE VIDEO TEST label, elapsed time and quiet stereo tones.
Video: Windows Media Video 8 (WMV2), 640x360, 30 fps, YUV420P, 1.5 Mbps target.
Audio: Windows Media Audio 2, stereo, 44.1 kHz, 128 kbps. Container: ASF/WMV.
No DRM. Fully decoded on the host without errors. Xbox playback is unverified.

First try the video in the stock Xbox video player. If it plays, put it beside
NativeVideoProbe/default.xex, preserving its selected.wmv filename, then run
the diagnostic. This separates codec/file compatibility from the handoff test.

The video-included USB ZIP contains the unchanged diagnostic-1 XEX/Assets
and this sample. It is not a new Blades release. The usual Blades install is
unaffected. Original generated test media: Blades project.
